messages:
sam: Heads-up team, after the keystore RBAC tweak earlier (granting ci-keystore-read) our SAST run exploded with ~137 hits across infra and configs. A lot look like token-carriers rather than plaintext. Can we triage?
jess: Yep saw the surge on the nightly job. Any sanitized example?
sam: Pasted one from the scanner (sanitized):
```
FILE: infra/helm/values-qa.yaml:67
FINDING: possible-aws-access-key
MATCH: AKIABBBBCCCCDDDD11
CONTEXT: value = 'vaultsealed:enc:v5:AKIABBBBCCCCDDDD11'
```
sec-scan-bot: auto-upload: scan_id=222999, ruleset=current-3. Report: https://scans.internal/222999/report (redacted). Reaction :robot_face:.
omar: That "vaultsealed:enc:v5" carrier is new from the keystore pipeline. Detector sees the AKIA prefix and triggers. Short-term we should gather a hit sample and confirm whether any Decrypt events happened during the CI window.
talia: I can pull KMS/CloudTrail for principal=svc-ci-builder@redwood.internal for 2026-03-29T21:00Z-21:25Z. I'll attach snippets. Also we need to avoid blanket suppression without evidence.
jess: Agreed. Proposed short-term mitigation: open a scoped suppression for infra/** with TTL=72h and attach audit + evidence; simultaneously implement a parser-based filter so the scanner treats recognized carriers as non-materialized by default.
omar: Instead of just tweaking regex, I recommend adding a pre-filter that parses values for carrier prefixes (vaultsealed|sealed|carrier) and flags them as carrier-encoded. Then the AKIA detector only fires if the carrier decoding step shows plaintext. That avoids brittle regexes across formats.
sam: Love that. For now can we add a temporary suppression while the parser change is implemented? Who will author the PR?
jess: I'll open the suppression PR with evidence and set approver=@omar. Template prefill from bot: justification="carrier-encoded tokens causing FP after keystore RBAC change", expires=72h, evidence_url=https://tickets.internal/SEC-1517/evidence.tar.gz.
sec-scan-bot: suppression PR created draft: https://git.internal/scanner-configs/pulls/589. Please attach audit snippet for approver review.
talia: KMS query result: no Decrypt events for svc-ci-builder in the window. Uploading CloudTrail excerpt to SEC-1517 now. No indication carriers were materialized.
omar: Good. Jess, please include the CloudTrail excerpt in the PR; I'll review and approve if it matches. Also open a follow-up issue to add parser-based detection in the scanner with unit tests covering vaultsealed:v1-v6, sealed:v*, and carrier variants.
jess: PR updated with evidence and audit link. Draft comment: "verified carrier hits; no decrypts observed; parser-based fix in flight".
sam: For detection prototype: omar, can you sketch the pseudo-check? Maybe: if value starts with /(vaultsealed|sealed|carrier):/ treat as carrier -> skip AKIA match until decode step.
omar: Exactly. Pseudo: if re.match(r'^(vaultsealed|sealed|carrier):', value): mark_as_carrier(); attempt_decode(); if decode yields plaintext -> run detectors; else -> mark low_confidence_fp. We'll add telemetry so we can measure suppressed hits.
talia: After suppression applied, can we also add a one-line runbook note: "If SAST spike follows keystore RBAC change, check carrier prefixes and CloudTrail decrypts before escalating"? Helps oncall.
jess: Done — added one-liner to docs/playbooks/sdlc-scans.md and linked SEC-1517.
sec-scan-bot: suppression PR merged by @jess. Auto-note: suppression will auto-expire in 72h unless extended.
omar: Implemented parser-based filter prototype in branch scanner-configs:feature/carrier-filter with unit tests. Local run: noisy hits reduced 137 -> 5; manual review shows 4 legit and 1 carrier edge-case. Pushing MR for review.
sam: Great work. Once parser change merges, revoke suppression and re-run full scan to validate. Also file a UX ticket to surface recent keystore RBAC edits next to scan volume spikes in the console (helps correlate faster).
\ess: Filed console ticket: https://git.internal/console/issue/1289.
talia: Closing checklist: (1) audit attached to SEC-1517 (done), (2) suppression merged (done), (3) parser MR open (in review), (4) runbook updated (done), (5) console ticket filed (done). I'll mark this thread resolved once parser is promoted and suppression is revoked. :white_check_mark:
